name: Blind Prism ~First Love~
original_name: ブラインドプリズム ~First Love~
source:
On the day of her high school's entrance ceremony, Mikoto Kuronagi collapsed with anemia and was helped by a stranger. His name was Hikaru Amamiya. An outgoing guy with a sparkling smile, Hikaru had been nicknamed "Prince", but he kept a secret close to his chest.

Through circumstance, the crossing paths of Mikoto and Hikaru deepened. He was acting very different as the school festival got closer. He was more testy with Mikoto. Takahisa realized that Mikoto liked Hikaru. One finds out the other's secret... and has his own...

Mired in "thoughts"... Mikoto starts the new year in a love triangle. Who and how she loves is in YOUR hands!

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ140225.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
高中入学典礼当天，黑薙美琴因贫血而倒下，得到了一位陌生人的帮助。他的名字叫天宫光。光是一个性格外向、笑容灿烂的人，被称为“王子”，但他却保守着一个秘密。

因缘际会，美琴和光的交集加深了。随着学园祭的临近，他的表现也大不相同了。他对美琴更加暴躁。高久意识到美琴喜欢光。一个人发现了对方的秘密……并且拥有了自己的……

深陷“思绪”……美琴在三角恋中开始了新的一年。她爱谁以及如何爱都在你的手中！

[编辑自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ140225.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
